annotations.title: Where to Go on Holiday by Month: Climate-Ranked Destination Finder

description: Scores each destination out of 100 for the chosen type of trip from its 1991–2020 monthly averages (ERA5 reanalysis, Copernicus C3S, CC BY 4.0): average daytime high against an ideal range per trip type, sea temperature for beaches, monthly rainfall above 60 mm and daytime cloud. The weights are modelling choices. avoidRain drops places in their rainy season that month: ≥ 180 mm, or ≥ 16 rainy days with ≥ 100 mm (not ski). Flying time is an estimate from great-circle distance (850 km/h + 0.5 h), not a schedule. Averages, not a forecast; no prices or availability. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/where-to-go-on-holiday-by-month

avoidRain.description: Leave out places in their rainy season that month.

maxFlightHours.description: Maximum estimated non-stop flying time from London Heathrow in hours; 0 for no limit.

month.description: Month of travel, lower case (january … december).

region.description: Limit to a region, or any.

tripType.description: any, beach, city, ski or safari. "any" scores each place on its best type.
